The multiple zeta value is defined as:
$$ \zeta(k_1, \dots, k_r) = \sum_{n_1 > \dots > n_r \ge 1} n_1^{-k_1} \cdots n_r^{-k_r} $$
The notation $\{2\}^m$ represents a string of $m$ ones in the exponent list, i.e., $2, 2, \dots, 2$.
Let's denote the left-hand side (LHS) of the given identities as:
$$ \text{LHS} = \zeta(\underbrace{2, \dots, 2}_{a-1}, 3, \underbrace{2, \dots, 2}_{c-1}, 1, \underbrace{2, \dots, 2}_{b}) $$
Let's count the total weight $w$ of the LHS. The weight is the sum of the exponents.
Weight($\text{LHS}$) = $(a-1)\times 2 + 3 + (c-1)\times 2 + 1 + b\times 2 = 2a - 2 + 3 + 2c - 2 + 1 + 2b = 2a + 2b + 2c$.
So the weight is $W = 2(a+b+c)$.

$$ \zeta(U) \zeta(V) = \zeta(U \star V) $$
